|Australians could spend close to four decades in retirement, raising questions about how well the nations retirement system accommodates longer lives and increasingly unpredictable exits from the workforce.

|Macquarie Group has named the chief investment officer for its wealth management business, following the departure of the former incumbent.

|ASIC has formed a time-limited markets expert advisory group to provide the regulator with advice, market expertise and international perspectives.
